m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read the inherited global doctrine (constellation-implementer references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present (docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md), plus the g1b IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.md, scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and the #440 sections of tests/test_spine_rail.py. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff + target module + existing #440 tests read; handoff complete

m1-guard.title: Refuse to guess when two guessed rungs name different files
m1-guard.imperative: TDD red then green. RED: add to tests/test_spine_rail.py a test where the main checkout AND a real git worktree both hold a valid checklist at the same relative path and the command carries NO told-truth signal; assert no entry is written and the store is byte-unchanged. Observe it FAIL against 9d44aa6 (git show 9d44aa6:scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py into a temp file / stash), paste the failure, restore and prove restored. GREEN: in resolve_spine_candidate, return the first validating TOLD-TRUTH rung (absolute/worktree_opt/cd_target) immediately, and among the GUESSED rungs keep the earliest validating candidate but bind NOTHING if a later guessed rung validates a DIFFERENT file; same file is agreement, not ambiguity. Do not reorder or rename rungs. Attest c1 (red observed), then advance so the engine runs c2.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the new ambiguity test written and observed FAILING against 9d44aa6 (manual attest; check MUST be null so the engine does not run the by-design-failing test)
Ambiguity among guessed rungs binds nothing; told-truth rungs still win outright; tests/test_spine_rail.py green

constraints: Allowed scope: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and tests/test_spine_rail.py only
PostToolUse never blocks and never raises; every new path returns {}
Told-truth rungs must not get slower, raise, or block; git probe stays off the told-truth path and stays bounded at 2.0s
Binding key shape and binding_key() untouched; do not restructure the ladder
Use python, never py; do not run the full suite; do not commit
A corner case not chased gets a comment at the code site plus a line in the result

m2-evidence.title: Produce the handoff's required evidence and write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m2-evidence.imperative: Run the handoff's verification command over BOTH test files, redirecting to a file and echoing the real exit code (a pipe to tail captures tail's code). Record git diff --numstat. Run the wiring grep for any new symbol and state the count. Then write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md to the handoff's return path. Attest c2 once the result file exists with real exit codes pasted in.

preconditions.statement: the guard is in and tests/test_spine_rail.py is green

postconditions.statement: python -m pytest tests/test_spine_rail.py tests/test_gauge_writer.py -q is green
IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md written to the handoff's return path with real exit codes, numstat, wiring grep count and workflow feedback

constraints: Evidence must carry REAL exit codes: redirect to a file, then echo $?
Do not commit; the Commander commits

why_trail.why: Handoff read in full and complete: task, protected intent, test mode (TDD required), close criteria, allowed scope, exclusions, constraints, map anchors, required evidence, wiring grep, verification commands, authority, stop conditions, return format all present. Baseline HEAD=9d44aa6 confirmed; both target files tracked (git check-ignore exit 1).

RED observed against unmodified 9d44aa6 (git diff --quiet on scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py exit 0 at the time): 3 of 7 new tests failed, headline being the store written where it had to stay byte-unchanged. GREEN: told-truth rungs (absolute/worktree_opt/cd_target) short-circuit; guessed rungs keep the earliest validating candidate and bind nothing when a later guess names a different file. 109 passed.

Both test files green at EXIT=0, 176 passed (169 baseline + 7 new). numstat: spine_rail.py 57/7, test_spine_rail.py 156/4 -- the 4 deletions are the one probe-spy test's docstring plus two assertions that became STRICTER, documented in the result. Wiring grep: TOLD_TRUTH_PATH_SOURCES has 1 call site outside its definition. Blast radius enumerated: 13 files mention path_source, 2 are code (both in scope), 11 are Commander-owned workflow artifacts, 0 docs stranded. IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md written to the handoff's return path.
